overview: Sam Wilson grapples with the legacy of the shield while Bucky Barnes confronts his dark Winter Soldier past.

episodes.title: New World Order
episodes.overview: Sam Wilson and Bucky Barnes address their personal challenges in a post-Blip world.

episodes.title: Power Broker
episodes.overview: Sam and Bucky turn to an unlikely ally, Helmut Zemo, for help tracking the Super Soldier Serum.

episodes.title: The Whole World Is Watching
episodes.overview: John Walker takes extreme measures as tensions escalate with the Flag Smashers.

episodes.title: Truth
episodes.overview: Sam reconciles his role in the nation’s future while John Walker faces consequences for his actions.

episodes.title: One World, One People
